title: Tesla offers his work to Soviet and German sources
summary: Kurt McConnell tells of Tesla offers his work to Soviet and German sources, about early 20th century at Soviet Union; Germany, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: But there's also, you know, stories about about Tesla also shopping some of his uh work and beliefs with Russian sources or Soviet sources with uh and with the Germans.

plain: A former US Senate staffer, Kurt McConnell, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2025 that there are stories of the inventor Nikola Tesla offering his work and ideas to Russian or Soviet contacts and to the Germans. If true, it would mean some of Tesla's inventions may have gone to rival powers abroad.
